dedupe_keys.name: fatigue constrained gradient based design optimization of main bearing shaft systems for floating wind turbine drivetrains

description: Gupta, Vasudev and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The implemented formulation extends WISDEM-WEIS/OpenMDAO to optimize main-bearing and shaft design with analytical bearing-fatigue constraints. A related multi-fidelity gradient-based publication is grouped as a method variant. The model object is the drivetrain assembly, not a complete independently validated wind farm. The deposited Utsira design inputs and result files have a separate data role. Public source availability for these specific extensions is not inferred from the open-source status of the underlying toolsets. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The source establishes an implemented or evaluated model. Public source-code availability remains unknown unless explicitly identified below. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance.
